architecture.mechanism: Automated vial transfer via a modular self‑loading cartridge that uses a low‑force gripper and motorized indexing to move vials from a user‑provided cartridge into the circular magazine, eliminating manual placement.
architecture.intervention: Add a replaceable cartridge module with a pneumatic suction gripper and a stepper‑motor‑driven carousel that indexes each vial into the turntable, integrated into the existing rigid chassis.
architecture.expected_effect: Manual handling error rate drops from >5% to <1% (≤1 misload per 100 vials) as measured by post‑run audit of vial positions.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a 10‑cycle trial with a single vial placed manually, then trigger the auto‑loader; if the gripper fails to pick or place the vial, the architecture is falsified.
